shared_style.medium: 2D editorial print illustration with clean vector-like silhouette edges and restrained ink/paper texture
shared_style.background: warm neutral paper-like field with sparse geometric/environmental motifs
shared_style.character: stylized non-photorealistic character with consistent catalog body proportions
shared_style.lighting: flat to limited tonal steps; no glossy cinematic lighting

crop_contract.result-portrait: primary face, hands and identity prop remain inside the central portrait-safe region
crop_contract.og-landscape: subject remains readable when lateral background is cropped to 1.91:1
crop_contract.share-portrait: subject and main role motif remain readable on a narrow mobile portrait card

representation_note: Representation variants rotate by catalog index only. They are editorial diversity slots and never inferred from personality, score, code, gender, ethnicity, age, disability, attractiveness, or social status.
